doc: ADR 0113 section A and B. Generated by crates/verso-server/src/access/vectors.rs; regenerate with VERSO_WRITE_VECTORS=1 cargo test -p verso-server access::vectors. A case is a table state (none: the path is in no table; open; closed), where the level comes from (source) and its level, then a kind, whether the person has the right to send files (right), whether a file the person sees shows the attachment or folder (derived), and an action; allow holds one letter per entry of who, in order: y allowed, n refused. A key a case does not name is one the answer does not depend on. Sources: nothing = no set on the path nor above it; file = the file's own set (whole table = level); folder = the folder's set only; exception = the file's own set under a folder's set that says something else; below-whole = the file's set with the whole table at edit and the player's own row at level; moved-in = the file's own set under a set on the table that says something else (K.2). The player is ana; a reader-other is another player, who falls to the whole table's row; the visitor of a read link has only the whole table's row.
